body.name: attainable Gaussian-tube calibration handle
body.construction: Analyze \(d_{H_N}(G_N+\lambda_N q_N(p),\mathcal C_N)^2\) by compactness of \((q_N,H_N)\), Gaussian tube probabilities for bounded \(\lambda_N\), separated tangent and endpoint half-plane limits for diverging \(|\lambda_N|\), and certified interval arithmetic over the physically attainable \((\lambda_N,p)\) set.
